title: Find patients who have had at least two laboratory tests with abnormal whit
question: Find patients who have had at least two laboratory tests with abnormal white blood cell count (WBC ≤ 3.5 or WBC ≥ 9.0) and also show total bilirubin (T-BIL) above 1.5 in any lab test. Return their ID, sex, and age.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    P."XCL_058",
    P."XCL_059",
    P."XCL_060"
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE P."XCL_058" IN (
    SELECT L."XCL_014"
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L."XCL_030" <= 3.5 OR L."XCL_030" >= 9.0
    GROUP BY L."XCL_014"
    HAVING COUNT(L."XCL_014") >= 2
)
AND P."XCL_058" IN (
    SELECT L."XCL_014"
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L."XCL_037" > 1.5
)

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT P."XCL_058", P."XCL_059", P."XCL_060"
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
GROUP BY P."XCL_058", P."XCL_059", P."XCL_060"
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN L."XCL_022" <= 3.5 OR L."XCL_022" >= 9.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN L."XCL_024" > 1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
